newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major to offer no new clues on poll day.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major to offer no new clues on poll day.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major will give no new clues as to the timing of the election when he addresses the annual Welsh conference of his Conservative Party on Friday, party aides said.
"You will get no clear steers," said one aide.
His speech is due at about at about 1300 GMT.
Major appeared to give a broad hint on Thursday that he had rejected the idea of a March 20 poll.
He told a television interviewer: "There is a general election in the near future, of course there is, but I think people should sit back and not get too excited."
The election must be held by May 22. -- London Newsroom 44 171 5427950
